about.title: About SQ CPA Firm
text: Based in Houston, Texas, SQ CPA Firm specializes in supporting contractors, 1099 income earners, and small business owners across a wide range of industries. Whether you’re in construction, technology, development, or home services, we’re here to help you save on taxes, streamline your operations, and set your business up for long-term success. With our expertise in accounting, tax preparation, payroll, and entity formation, we’re more than just a tax service—we’re your partner in growth.

Every business deserves the financial advantages of having a dedicated, professional accounting team without the overhead costs of hiring one in-house. At SQ CPA Firm, we offer the expertise of full-time CPAs at a fraction of the price, ensuring your business thrives without the heavy financial burden of maintaining an internal accounting staff. We’re especially experienced in helping businesses with 10-20 employees and those looking to grow and scale efficiently.

We exist to make your business more productive, efficient, and profitable. By delivering strategic financial guidance, we help you keep more of your hard-earned money while ensuring full compliance with all regulations. From real estate tax strategies to proactive business planning, we give you the peace of mind you need to focus on what matters most—growing your business.
